title: Fleece blankets for 60 families at the Riverbend school shelter
description: 60 fleece blankets, one for each family sleeping on the school gym floor since the river flooded their homes. Nights are dropping below 10C. Bought from Valley Supply Co. and handed out at the shelter.

title: Tarps to cover 40 storm-damaged roofs
description: 40 heavy-duty waterproof tarps (10 x 12 ft) to cover roofs torn open by the storm until repairs can start, so families can stay in their homes. Bought from Valley Supply Co. and fitted by volunteers.

title: Sleeping mats for the Eastside evacuation centre
description: 10 foam sleeping mats for older evacuees sleeping on the concrete floor of the Eastside evacuation centre. Bought from Valley Supply Co. and handed out at the centre.

title: Hygiene kits for 120 people displaced by the flood
description: 120 hygiene kits - soap, toothbrush, toothpaste, sanitary pads and a towel in each - for people staying with relatives after losing their homes. Collected by each family.
